name: Post a Slack message
description: Posts plain text to one Slack channel with the stored bot token and returns the channel id and message timestamp. The token never leaves the enclave.
author: Lit Protocol

channel.description: Channel id (C0123…) or #name the bot has joined

threadTs.description: Reply in this thread instead of posting a new message

ui.label: Post Slack messages inside Lit
ui.hint: Agents can post text to channels the bot has joined. The bot token is never revealed and the action reaches only slack.com.
